findings.issue: Worker Dockerfile missing HEALTHCHECK instruction - Docker will not monitor container health
findings.impact: If the worker process becomes unresponsive (stuck job, deadlock), Docker/Host orchestrator will not detect the failure or restart the container. Silent worker outage.
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD wget --spider http://localhost:4100/healthz || exit 1

findings.issue: Dependabot GitHub Actions ecosystem has no version grouping - each action version bump creates a separate PR
findings.impact: Noise from individual action update PRs may cause developers to ignore or batch-merge updates without review. Missed security-critical version bumps.
findings.fix: Add groups: block for GitHub Actions ecosystem (similar to npm ecosystem group)

findings.issue: All runtime Docker images install wget (~1MB) solely for HEALTHCHECK purposes
findings.impact: Unnecessary dependency in production images. wget could be replaced with Node.js built-in fetch for health checks.
findings.fix: Replace wget HEALTHCHECK with node -e "fetch('http://localhost:PORT/healthz')" or add a tiny Node.js healthcheck script

findings.issue: Dependabot npm ecosystem has no explicit allow or ignore lists - potential noise from low-value dependency updates
findings.impact: Weekly updates may include unnecessary bumps for devDependencies or low-impact packages. Could be tuned for higher signal-to-noise ratio.
findings.fix: Add allow: list scoped to production dependencies, or add ignore: list for specific low-value packages
